name: Dumbbell Finger Curl
steps: Sit on a bench holding dumbbells palms up with your forearms supported on your thighs and hands beyond your knees.
Let the handles roll toward the bent tips of your fingers without losing contact.
Close your fingers to roll the handles back into your palms.
tips: Keep your wrists still to isolate the motion at your fingers.
Roll the dumbbells slowly so they never slip from your fingertips.
